atlases.prompt:
Create a production bitmap ICON ATLAS for a PC pirate tactical MMORPG. Premium hand-painted HD 2D ability artwork, crisp illustrative brushwork, rich material detail, strong readable silhouettes, dramatic luminous highlights, beautiful color gradients and deep dark atmospheric backgrounds. These are finished square inventory/skill artworks, not symbols or line icons. Each cell is a separate full-bleed painting with its subject large and centered. No character portraits or full people; isolated weapons, hands or magical effects only. No text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, outer frame, bevels, decorative UI borders, gaps or margins. EXACT regular grid occupying the entire canvas edge to edge, all cells identically sized, no element crosses between cells. Consistent painterly fantasy RPG art style. Each panel must remain visually distinct and readable at 48px. Landscape atlas, exactly FIVE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, twenty separate panels. Target canvas 2000x1600 pixels. Read in row-major order:
ROW 1, SWORD skills:
1. Single brilliant gold curved sword slash with a silver pirate saber.
2. Two intersecting golden saber cuts forming a dynamic X.
3. Traveling powerful crescent blade of cyan-blue energy, luminous white edge and blue trailing streaks.
4. Extremely sharp slender golden thrust shooting straight forward, a saber tip with a piercing light spear.
5. Dense cyan-blue cyclone formed by spinning sword blades and sweeping wind arcs.
ROW 2, SPIKED CLUB skills:
1. Heavy dark iron spiked pirate club with a brown leather grip, bold downward impact.
2. Spiked club crushing a rock into flying fragments with a concentrated amber impact flash.
3. A golden semicircular shockwave racing outward from a club strike.
4. Cracked earth radiating beneath an iron club, molten amber energy in the fissures.
5. Massive iron studded club descending like a meteor, white-gold collision explosion, epic scale.
ROW 3, PIRATE FIREARM skills:
1. Antique flintlock pistol firing one bright amber muzzle burst, warm steel and walnut.
2. Antique flintlock pistol with a sharply focused red-orange aiming reticle and a gold bullet.
3. Blunderbuss muzzle blasting a spreading cluster of glowing lead pellets, smoky gold flash.
4. Several glowing bullets racing in parallel with repeated orange muzzle flashes.
5. One elongated superheated bullet piercing consecutive steel plates, golden straight trajectory.
ROW 4, DAGGER skills:
1. Polished short dagger stabbing forward, a tight pale gold thrust trail.
2. Extremely fast dagger cut with two thin bright gold sweeping arcs.
3. Flying steel throwing dagger surrounded by narrow gold speed streaks on deep teal.
4. Razor dagger tip striking the center of a crimson glowing weak-point target, intense precise impact.
5. Several spinning silver daggers forming a circular dance of pale gold light.
No repeated weapon silhouette across all twenty cells; illustrate the distinct action of each skill.
